# Nexa Hub Services

> Nexa Hub Services (nexahubservices.in) is an Ahmedabad-based business services firm founded by Yogi Surendra Nath. It empowers startups and MSMEs with strategic advisory, government funding support, business registration and compliance — delivered online across India with quick response and complete support.

## Signature services
- [PMEGP Loan Scheme](https://nexahubservices.in/services/pmegp-loan): Eligibility check, bankable project report, KVIC portal application and bank follow-up. Project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (service) with 15–35% subsidy.
- [Startup India (DPIIT) Registration](https://nexahubservices.in/services/startup-india): DPIIT recognition, Section 80-IAC tax exemption application, Seed Fund guidance.
- [GST Registration & Return Filing](https://nexahubservices.in/services/gst-services): New GSTIN, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, amendments, notices.
- [Trademark Registration](https://nexahubservices.in/services/trademark-registration): Search, TM-A filing, objection replies, renewal.
- [MSME (Udyam) Registration](https://nexahubservices.in/services/msme-registration): Udyam registration, NSIC/GeM, MSME Samadhaan.
- [FSSAI Food Licence](https://nexahubservices.in/services/fssai-registration): Basic registration, State and Central licences, renewals.
- [Import Export Code (IEC)](https://nexahubservices.in/services/iec-registration): New IEC, annual update, RCMC.

## Other services
- [Company & Business Registration](https://nexahubservices.in/services/business-registration) · [Project Reports & CMA](https://nexahubservices.in/services/project-reports) · [Loan Documentation](https://nexahubservices.in/services/loan-documentation)
- Also: Mudra and CGTMSE loan support.

## Key facts
- Business name: Nexa Hub Services
- Founder: Yogi Surendra Nath

- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98750 37579

- Pricing: "Starting from" professional fees for most registrations; company incorporation, new GST registration and government funding services are quoted on consultation. Government fees are charged at actuals.
- Track record: 1,250+ clients, ₹25 Cr+ funds raised, ₹5 Cr+ grants, 2,150+ certificates.
